text: Create simple enum object contains read-values/types: Create enum objects enforce types: Change class enum objects define custom methods:
code: library(enum)  enum(a = 1, b = TRUE, c = "text", d = list(x = 1), e = mean) #> Enum with members: #>  $a : num 1 #>  $b : logi TRUE #>  $c : chr "text" #>  $d :List of 1 $ x: num 1 #>  $e :function (x, ...) enum_lgl(yes = TRUE, no = FALSE, unknown = NA) #> Enum with <lgl> members: #>  $no      : logi FALSE #>  $unknown : logi NA #>  $yes     : logi TRUE  enum_bool(yes = TRUE, no = FALSE, unknown = NA) #> Error: #> ! `enum_bool` members must be single logical (non-NA) values.  enum_dbl(yes = 1.0, no = 2.0, maybe = NA_real_) #> Enum with <dbl> members: #>  $maybe : num NA #>  $no    : num 2 #>  $yes   : num 1  enum_num(yes = 1L, no = 2.0, maybe = NA_real_) #> Enum with <num> members: #>  $maybe : num NA #>  $no    : num 2 #>  $yes   : int 1  enum_chr(yes = "yes", no = "no", maybe = "") #> Enum with <chr> members: #>  $maybe : chr "" #>  $no    : chr "no" #>  $yes   : chr "yes"  enum_str(yes = "yes", no = "no", maybe = "") #> Error: #> ! `enum_str` members must be single (non-NA) strings. mc <- enum(   SUBSCRIPTION_COST = 1000,   MEMBER = TRUE,   MEMBER_DISCOUNT = 10L,   class = "SubCost" )  subscription_cost <- function(x, ...) {   UseMethod("subscription_cost") }  subscription_cost.SubCost <- function(x, ...) {   x$SUBSCRIPTION_COST * (1 - x$MEMBER_DISCOUNT / 100) }  subscription_cost(mc) #> [1] 900  # or create a enum template create_color <- function(r, g, b) {   enum_int(r = r, g = g, b = b, class = "Color") }  red <- create_color(r = 255L, g = 0L, b = 0L) green <- create_color(r = 0L, g = 255L, b = 0L) blue <- create_color(r = 0L, g = 0L, b = 255L)

code: enum(a = 1, b = TRUE, c = "text", d = list(x = 1), e = mean) #> Enum with members: #>  $a : num 1 #>  $b : logi TRUE #>  $c : chr "text" #>  $d :List of 1 $ x: num 1 #>  $e :function (x, ...)    # enforce type enum_lgl(yes = TRUE, no = FALSE, unknown = NA) #> Enum with <lgl> members: #>  $no      : logi FALSE #>  $unknown : logi NA #>  $yes     : logi TRUE try(enum_bool(yes = TRUE, no = FALSE, unknown = NA)) #> Error : `enum_bool` members must be single logical (non-NA) values.  enum_num(yes = 1L, no = 2.0, maybe = NA_real_) #> Enum with <num> members: #>  $maybe : num NA #>  $no    : num 2 #>  $yes   : int 1 try(enum_nmbr(yes = 1L, no = 2.0, maybe = Inf)) #> Error : `enum_nmbr` members must be scalar finite numerics.  enum_chr(text = "hello", empty = "", missing = NA_character_) #> Enum with <chr> members: #>  $empty   : chr "" #>  $missing : chr NA #>  $text    : chr "hello" try(enum_str(text = "hello", empty = "", missing = NA_character_)) #> Error : `enum_str` members must be single (non-NA) strings.  # add class at construction class(enum(red = 1, class = "Color")) #> [1] "Color"       "enum"        "environment"
